content.title: Application resume
content.subtitle: Job wala resume aur application wala resume thoda alag hota hai.

steps.title: Chhota rakho
steps.detail: Zyada lamba hoga toh zaroori cheezein chhup jaayengi. Jo course se juda hai, wahi rakho.

steps.title: Education sabse upar
steps.detail: Degree, college aur score pehle. Uske baad projects aur experience.

steps.title: Projects ka result likho
steps.detail: Kya banaya, kaunse tools use kiye aur result kya nikla. Chhoti, seedhi lines.

steps.title: Course se match karo
steps.detail: Data Science ke liye apply kar rahe ho? Data wale projects pehle dikhao.

steps.title: Simple format
steps.detail: Ek font, saaf headings, PDF mein bhejo. Fancy design ki zaroorat nahi.

caption:
Application ke liye resume bana rahe ho? Ye 5 steps follow karo 👇

1. Chhota rakho
2. Education sabse upar
3. Projects ka result likho
4. Course se match karo
5. Simple format

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
